nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza B and HMPV are in the ‘High’ category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category. The other respiratory viruses (RSV, Influenza A, and EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide & not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/sOsQmvCwjb

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/0jomxGy89c

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (77.5%) and KP.3 in light blue (6.3%) make up approximately 84% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/wN4SpnLJWP

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. Flu B is in seasonal onset and in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend. 47% and 52% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/TeOkYXQe4N

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 26 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 7 in the South, and 6 in the Northeast. As of 4/23/25, 17 states reported infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections have been in CA, IA, MD, MN, & NJ. https://t.co/bfA25ejDHw

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. 44% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/VaCsebqyBK

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘High’ category nationally, with high concentrations and a downward trend. 51% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV. https://t.co/pxIXyoxa1Y

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions except the West remain in the ‘High’ category. https://t.co/8LteDx5jj1
